items.stanza_title: Title · Poet
items.display: First Snow ― Myungdojae Lee Myung-woo

items.stanza_title: Stanza 1 · First Snow & Longing
items.display: Quietly, I call out the name of the first snow

items.stanza_title: Stanza 1 · First Snow & Longing
items.display: Standing in the schoolyard, the day slows down

items.stanza_title: Stanza 1 · First Snow & Longing
items.display: A cool breeze gently rests upon my cheek

items.stanza_title: Stanza 1 · First Snow & Longing
items.display: A single white snowflake

items.stanza_title: Stanza 1 · First Snow & Longing
items.display: Settles on my shoulder like an old longing

items.stanza_title: Stanza 2 · White Flutter in the Schoolyard
items.display: The schoolyard where we built a snowman as children

items.stanza_title: Stanza 2 · White Flutter in the Schoolyard
items.display: That girl who smiled, blowing warmth into her small hands

items.stanza_title: Stanza 2 · White Flutter in the Schoolyard
items.display: Put two dark eyes upon the snowman

items.stanza_title: Stanza 2 · White Flutter in the Schoolyard
items.display: And left a white flutter inside my heart

items.stanza_title: Stanza 3 · The Promise of First Snow
items.display: The words saying, let us meet again when the first snow falls

items.stanza_title: Stanza 3 · The Promise of First Snow
items.display: I cannot recall who spoke them first

items.stanza_title: Stanza 3 · The Promise of First Snow
items.display: Yet every year when the first snow comes

items.stanza_title: Stanza 3 · The Promise of First Snow
items.display: I quietly take out that promise alone

items.stanza_title: Stanza 4 · Warm Footprints & Little Flower
items.display: In the place where the girl once passed

items.stanza_title: Stanza 4 · Warm Footprints & Little Flower
items.display: Do her warm footprints still remain?

items.stanza_title: Stanza 4 · Warm Footprints & Little Flower
items.display: Is the heart I could not confess that day

items.stanza_title: Stanza 4 · Warm Footprints & Little Flower
items.display: Blooming like a tiny flower buried in the snow?

items.stanza_title: Stanza 5 · First Snow Falling Today
items.display: Today again, the first snow falls on the schoolyard

items.stanza_title: Stanza 5 · First Snow Falling Today
items.display: The snowman is no longer there

items.stanza_title: Stanza 5 · First Snow Falling Today
items.display: And I do not know where that girl lives now

items.stanza_title: Stanza 6 · The Boy Waiting Within
items.display: Whenever the day of the first snow arrives

items.stanza_title: Stanza 6 · The Boy Waiting Within
items.display: A young boy deep within my heart

items.stanza_title: Stanza 6 · The Boy Waiting Within
items.display: Is still waiting for that girl.
